description: Taurus and Scorpio compatibility in Western astrology: Earth and Water, fixed and fixed, the 180° opposition between them, and what helps the pairing.
answer: In Western astrology, Taurus (fixed Earth) and Scorpio (fixed Water) sit 180 degrees apart, a complementary match in which each element feeds the other. Taurus is often described as reliable and patient and Scorpio as passionate and resourceful; Sun signs describe tendencies, not outcomes.

sections.heading: How Taurus and Scorpio show up together
paragraphs: Taurus and Scorpio sit opposite each other, both fixed and deeply loyal. Taurus brings calm and sensuality, Scorpio brings intensity and depth. The attraction can be powerful and lasting, and so can the stubbornness when both dig in.

Taurus tends to love steadily and sensually. The sign is linked with patience and loyalty, so a Taurus partner often builds trust slowly, shows care through comfort and practical reliability, and enjoys shared routines such as meals, music and familiar places. In conversation with Scorpio, Taurus tends to be measured and deliberate. It listens, takes its time and prefers to return to a topic once it has thought it through.

Scorpio tends to love intensely and privately. As a Sun sign it is linked with depth, loyalty and transformation, so a Scorpio partner often wants emotional honesty, commits fully once trust is earned and notices what others try to hide. In conversation with Taurus, Scorpio tends to be focused and probing, more interested in what is underneath a statement than in small talk.

On first meeting Scorpio, Taurus often comes across as calm, warm and grounded, with an unhurried manner that makes people relax. On first meeting Taurus, Scorpio often comes across as composed, perceptive and slightly mysterious, giving away less than it notices. Put together, Taurus brings steadiness and a sense of home, while Scorpio brings depth, loyalty and emotional honesty.

sections.heading: Earth meets Water: element and modality
paragraphs: Taurus and Scorpio combine Earth and Water, which astrology treats as complementary elements: water nourishes earth. Taurus offers stability and practical care, Scorpio offers emotional depth and intuition, so this pairing is often nurturing, loyal and protective. The risk is that Taurus and Scorpio both become cautious and inward-looking. An Earth-Water pair like Taurus and Scorpio tends to do well when it keeps some outside stimulation in its life.

Taurus and Scorpio are both fixed signs, the signs in the middle of each season. Fixed energy is associated with persistence and loyalty, so this pair can be deeply committed and steady. The shared risk is stubbornness: when two fixed signs disagree, neither naturally gives way, so deliberate compromise matters. Both are receptive signs in traditional astrology (Fire and Air are active, Earth and Water receptive), so Taurus and Scorpio tend to meet the world with a similar inward, receptive stance. The traditional keywords for Taurus include reliable, patient and practical, and those for Scorpio include passionate, resourceful and determined.

sections.heading: The 180° relationship: opposition
paragraphs: Taurus and Scorpio sit opposite each other, 180 degrees apart, which matches the opposition in traditional astrology. Taurus shares a modality and a complementary element with Scorpio, and the two are often read as halves of one theme. A Taurus-Scorpio opposition can feel magnetic, with Taurus embodying what Scorpio is learning and the reverse, and it can polarise when neither meets in the middle. In practice, Taurus and Scorpio tend to thrive when each borrows a little of the other's approach, turning polarity into balance.

Counting from Aries, Taurus is sign 2 and Scorpio is sign 8, which is where the 180-degree figure comes from: each sign spans 30 degrees. Taurus is ruled by Venus, the planet astrology links with love, pleasure and values, and Scorpio is ruled by Pluto, which modern astrology links with depth, power and transformation, so a Taurus-Scorpio pairing is often read as Venus meeting Pluto. For Taurus and Scorpio, this is a relationship between whole signs rather than an aspect calculated from two birth charts.

sections.heading: Needs, friction and what helps
paragraphs: With Scorpio, Taurus usually needs security, consistency and time to adjust, along with physical affection and a partner who keeps their word. With Taurus, Scorpio usually needs trust, depth and a partner who is willing to talk about real feelings rather than surface ones.

When stressed around Scorpio, Taurus can dig in, resist change on principle and go quiet rather than discuss what is wrong. Under stress around Taurus, Scorpio can become guarded, suspicious or controlling, and may test a partner instead of asking directly. With two fixed signs, neither partner gives way easily in an argument, so agreeing in advance that each will concede one point tends to break deadlocks gracefully.

What helps Scorpio with Taurus is advance notice, unhurried time together, and showing reliability over weeks rather than trying to win a point in one evening. What helps Taurus with Scorpio is transparency, keeping confidences, and being willing to stay with an intense conversation rather than deflecting it. Naming Taurus' resistance to change and Scorpio's guardedness as patterns, rather than as faults, tends to make them easier to work with, and much easier to laugh about later.

sections.heading: Taurus and Scorpio day to day
paragraphs: At home, Taurus tends to invest in comfort, good bedding, a well-stocked kitchen, plants and music, and it appreciates a Scorpio who enjoys those pleasures rather than rushing past them. For its part at home, Scorpio tends to guard privacy, prefer depth to small talk and create a space that feels intimate, and it values a Taurus who keeps confidences.

As a teammate, Taurus is steady, patient and hard to rattle; alongside a Scorpio, it brings follow-through and asks for clear expectations before deadlines move. In turn, as a teammate, Scorpio investigates, strategises and stays focused under pressure; working with a Taurus, it does best with trust, autonomy and honest information. Shared projects that use both the reliable side of Taurus and the passionate side of Scorpio, a trip, a renovation, a joint hobby, tend to show this pairing at its best.

In daily rhythm, Taurus and Scorpio often create a homely, protective routine with good food and quiet evenings; inviting friends round now and then brings in the outside energy this cosy pairing can lack.

faq.question: Are Taurus and Scorpio compatible?
faq.answer: Taurus and Scorpio have complementary elements (Earth and Water) and sit 180 degrees apart, a complementary match in which each element feeds the other. Astrology describes themes rather than scores; for Taurus and Scorpio, the themes to watch are Taurus' resistance to change and Scorpio's guardedness.

faq.question: What are the dates and elements of Taurus and Scorpio?
faq.answer: In 2026, the Sun is in Taurus from Apr 20 – May 20 and in Scorpio from Oct 23 – Nov 21. Taurus is a Fixed Earth sign ruled by Venus; Scorpio is a Fixed Water sign ruled by Pluto. Cusp dates can shift by a day between years.

faq.question: What does the 180° angle between Taurus and Scorpio mean?
faq.answer: Counting around the zodiac, Scorpio sits 180 degrees from Taurus, an opposition in traditional terms. It describes how Taurus and Scorpio relate as signs, not an aspect between planets in two people's charts.

faq.question: What might Taurus and Scorpio enjoy doing together?
faq.answer: Taurus usually enjoys sensory, unhurried outings: long dinners, wine tastings, gardens, concerts, massages and weekends in beautiful, quiet places, while Scorpio usually enjoys intense, absorbing outings: mysteries, thrillers, deep-water swimming, late-night conversations and travel off the beaten path. Alternating who chooses gives both partners a taste of the other's world.
